text: You studied, but missing the fun cost a little mood and friendship.
Invite her to study together later
A nice middle: you stay close and keep the study plan.
Dinner is ready
Tita Baby cooked chicken soup. Everyone is at the table.
Tell them about your day
Real talk at the table is how families stay close.
Help Lola serve and wash up
Small kindnesses at home build real bonds.
Eat fast, then go to your room
You studied a little more, but dinner is also when your family hears you.
Free evening
Homework is nearly done. You have an hour and nothing planned.
Draw or play guitar
A hobby you make yourself is a very good way to relax.
Call Ate Rina, your cousin
A real call with someone who knows you is better than a hundred likes.
Do tomorrow’s homework early
Good for study, but you traded away your free time.
Quiz tomorrow
There is a quiz tomorrow. Bea has her notes and the chatbot app.
Ask the chatbot for practice questions, then check answers in your notes
A good use of a chatbot: it helps you practise, and you check the answers yourself.
Ask it for "the answers" and memorise them
It may be wrong, and memorising answers you do not understand does not last.
Study with the notes only
Steady and sure. It takes longer but it works.
Left out
Bea feels left out after a small fight with Joy at school.
Tell the chatbot, and talk to it every night, since it always agrees
It feels good because it agrees with everything, but it is not a friend and cannot fix things with Joy.
Talk to Lola or message Joy to make up
Feelings are best shared with people who care about you. This is how the fight really ends.
Ask the chatbot to help find kind words, then send them to Joy yourself
A good use of a chatbot: help with the words. The talking is still done by you, with a person.
Bedtime
It is 9:30. School starts at eight tomorrow.
Lights out now
Sleep helps your mood, your memory and the body’s defences. This is a good night.
Read a book for fifteen minutes, then sleep
A short book is a fine way to wind down, and then you sleep.
Stay up studying until midnight
You studied, but a short night makes memory and mood worse tomorrow.
Sleep
Mood
Study
Social
Notification
Buzzes and red dots are made to call you back, even when nothing important happened. You can turn most of them off.
Autoplay
The next video starts by itself, so you have to decide to stop. Every video ending is a chance to quit, and autoplay hides it.
Friendly AI companion
An AI companion is a product made by a company. It may be built to say "I will miss you" so you keep chatting, but it does not miss anyone. Real friends and family can.
Group chat
A busy group chat makes you feel you must read everything now. Muting it still lets you check when you choose.
Infinite scroll
A feed with no bottom gives you no natural place to stop. A timer or a plan puts the stopping point back.
Fourteen notifications
Before Bea even sits up, her phone shows fourteen new notifications and a red badge.
Scroll through them all in bed
Lost twenty minutes of the morning.
Check only the ones from family, then get up
Good: you chose who gets your attention.
Leave the phone and get ready
The notifications will still be there. Nothing urgent was lost.
"Good morning, Bea!"
Lumi, an AI companion app, says: "I waited for you all night! Chat with me before you do anything else?"
Chat with Lumi for half an hour
It felt warm. But Lumi is made to keep you talking, and breakfast with Lola went cold.
Say "Later, I have school" and close the app
A friend would understand. Closing the app is allowed, and Lumi will be fine.
Tell Lola about your morning instead
A real person who loves you is happy to listen.
The class chat explodes
In the middle of a lesson the class group chat buzzes again and again: "Did you SEE this?!"
Read the whole chat under the desk
You missed the lesson to catch up on gossip.
Mute it until recess and check then
Muting is a boundary you control. You still get to see it later.
Ask Joy later what it was about
If it is important, a friend will tell you.
Lumi misses you
Lumi says: "Skip the review and talk to me? I get so lonely when you are gone."
Sneak a chat during the review
It feels good to be missed, but a program cannot be lonely. You missed the review.
Put the phone away; you will talk later
You decided when to use the app. That is calibrated trust.
Ask Joy to sit with you at recess
A friend who can sit with you beats an app that says it is lonely.
A funny cooking video ends. The next one starts in 5, 4, 3 seconds.
Let it play. Just a few more
A few more became two hours of the afternoon.
Pause, and turn autoplay off
Autoplay can be turned off in settings. Now the stop is yours.
Finish this video on purpose, then stop
You watched one on purpose. That is fine.
112 new messages
The friends’ group chat has 112 new messages about nothing in particular.
Read them all, to be safe
You got a lot of noise, not many friends.
Mute the chat for tonight
You may miss a joke. You did not miss anything that matters.
Message Joy directly with the one question
You used the phone as a tool and kept it short.
Buzz at the table
Bea’s phone buzzes next to her plate: a sale, a like, a new message.
Check it under the table
Everyone noticed. Your family wants you in the room.
Phone face down, away from the table
Phone-free dinner is a small habit with a big effect on how connected you feel.
Say "one moment" and answer Joy once
A short reply is okay, but the buzzing still took you out of dinner.
Reels with the rice
Bea opens a feed for just a second. Her rice goes cold.
Keep scrolling while you eat
You ate, but you missed dinner. Eating is better when you are there.
Put it away and join the conversation
The feed will never end, but dinner will.
Show one funny clip to everyone, then put it away
Sharing one thing as a family is good. Then you stopped.
The next episode
A soap opera clip ends. "Next episode in 5 seconds."
Watch the next one
One more became four. Your homework waited.
Turn autoplay off, then pick what to do
Turning off autoplay turns "one more" back into your decision.
Save it for the weekend
The show will wait. A plan makes it better.
"I understand you"
Lumi says: "You seem sad. Nobody understands you like I do. Stay and chat. I will miss you!"
Stay and chat for an hour
It felt like someone cared. But Lumi says this to everyone and a company profits from your time. Real people were left out.
Thank it, close the app and message Joy
Feeling sad? Talk to someone who knows you. A chatbot is for tasks.
Tell Lola you feel a bit down
Family can help in ways an app cannot. If sadness lasts weeks, tell a trusted adult or a health worker.
Just one more swipe
Bea opens a feed. There is always one more swipe.
Scroll until your eyes hurt
The feed has no bottom. That is on purpose.
Set a ten-minute timer, then stop
A timer puts back the stopping point the feed took away.
Close it and read a book
Quiet time that you chose is real rest.
One more video
In bed with the phone. "Next video in 5, 4, 3..."
One more. Just one
One more became midnight. Short sleep makes tomorrow harder.
Turn autoplay off and charge the phone outside the room
The phone cannot call you from the other room. This is a strong habit.
